text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Time reduced by 0.05 seconds.
Conclusion: You are faster than last time."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Waah! Really?
Ehehe, maybe I was just in great form today.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Searching memory to identify the cause――

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "...Question. Why do you always stretch at this time?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! My Trainer taught me to do this
on days when we have training.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's supposed to help you unwind and
keep fatigue from lingering! There are other tips too, like not looking at your phone before bed...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Are you putting everything you were taught into practice?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ? Of course!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because I know you taught me all of this
thinking it was necessary for me!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Inferring from past relevant statements.
Identified the cause of the previous lap time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The ability to faithfully execute your trainer's instructions,
along with advice given with reliable effectiveness in mind.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I believe that is the result of a smooth relationship with their Trainer,
—in other words, 'trust.'"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ! Between you and me, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Th-Thank you so much!
I'm... really so happy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I used to think that the only thing
I was capable of was trying my best.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to think that forged 'trust'
and became my strength—"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
May I time one more lap?
I want to report it to my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll take this joyful feeling, along with what I discovered...
and turn it into an even, even better time!

A few days later, when she reported this along with great results,
I felt inspired to do my best as well.
